page.overview:
Who is Navi?

Since Link is not a Kokiri but actually a Hylian and does not have a Fairy to call his own, Navi is summoned by the Great Deku Tree to accompany him on his quest to save Hyrule as a partner. Throughout the Nintendo 64 game, Navi provides Link with a variety of clues to help him solve puzzles and progress in his quest. Navi also helps the Hero of Time learn the main controls in the game, teaching him how to open doors and how to push and pull blocks. The player can listen to Navi's advice by pressing the C-Up Button in the controller whenever her name flashes on the screen, which she yells out "[https://noproblo.dayjo.org/zeldasounds/OOT/OOT_Navi_Hey3.wav Hey!]". When the button is pressed, she will say "[https://noproblo.dayjo.org/zeldasounds/OOT/OOT_Navi_Listen3.wav Listen!]". She does this to guide Link on his next objective (similarly to Kaepora Geabora and Sheik) or explain an enemy's abilities or weaknesses.

Navi's primary purpose is to function as a focusing target. By pressing the Z Button, Navi targets the most nearby object, enemy, or person. She glows yellow to indicate when she is targeting an enemy, blue when Link can talk to someone from a distance, and green when she is targeting something of interest. Any time Navi targets an enemy or something suspicious, she yells out to Link "Hey!", "[https://noproblo.dayjo.org/zeldasounds/OOT/OOT_Navi_Look3.wav Look!]", or "[https://noproblo.dayjo.org/zeldasounds/OOT/OOT_Navi_WatchOut3.wav Watch out!]" Pressing the C-Up Button while targeting an enemy allows Link to hear Navi's information about said foe. Once Link learns "Saria's Song," he can communicate with Saria through Navi. When Navi's help is not being used, she seemingly hides herself inside Link's hat. However, she can be summoned at any time by pressing the A Button while Link is standing still (she will return to his hat if remaining still for 5 seconds). In , Navi also often tells Link to take a rest from playing, breaking the 4th wall to players.

Although Navi can target most enemies or bosses and give Link clues on how to defeat them, during the battle against , Navi is unable to help him due to the waves of darkness produced by the King of Evil (though she can still target him gameplay-wise). Once Link defeats Ganondorf and escapes the crumbling Ganon's Castle along with Princess Zelda, Navi apologizes to him for not having helped him in the battle. However, Ganondorf emerges shortly after from the castle ruins and transforms into Ganon. Navi, willing to aid Link, exclaims that she will not be held back by the villain again and joins him in the final battle (although like Ganon's human form, she does not know the weaknesses of the demon), where they eventually defeat the King of Evil. After Princess Zelda sends the Hero of Time back to his original time, Navi can be seen leaving Link's side for undisclosed reasons as she flies away into the lit window inside the Temple of Time, as her mission of guiding him to save Hyrule has been completed.

Also known as: Hey Listen.
